verdict.rationale: Klaviyo publishes extensive public REST API documentation. It covers private-key and OAuth authentication with scopes, concrete write endpoints such as creating campaigns and events, webhooks, cursor pagination and sparse fieldsets, and rate-limit headers with Retry-After. It also offers an importable spec for Postman, official SDKs, test accounts, and explicitly states it can be used headlessly by people and AI agents. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as documented for driving the product end-to-end.
